findings.reconstruction: The original target's blue coat and face are no longer visible, but the selected area remains an obvious target-shaped blur with colored edge artifacts and little plausible photographic background detail. Native RAW Auto rendering remains visibly unsuitable for accepted removal. This does not establish complete semantic closure; it fails overall photographic reconstruction.
findings.preservation: Actual shared RAW inverse, durable fp16 codec and native rendering preserve exact known/protected samples in18 independently checked Auto/Neutral exposure/WB renders. No accepted sidecar was written.
findings.timing_memory: One uncontrolled M5 Max128 GiB run; about697 seconds and45.94 GB logical MLX peak. This is not device RSS, controlled p50/p95, nor supported16/24/32 GiB qualification. No optimized phase ownership or cache protocol is established for Qwen.
findings.decision: No Qwen model/runtime, wider-hole policy, color conversion or product configuration admitted. Photographic-contrast model encoding remains worth evaluating, with no causal conclusion about the current haze.

scientific_figure.scope: Display comparison of native RAW crops; no perceptual color gate or ground-truth quality measure.

limitations: One public RAW; visually reviewed SAM instance/protection, no independent whole-object/role labels, hidden-background truth or verified person releases.
Published artifact hashes and declared Apache2 licenses are provenance only; conversion equivalence, transitive terms, distribution/signing and full admission remain unresolved.
Native canonical RAW conversion/preservation does not establish reconstruction quality, texture/noise, accepted edit history/export portability or device performance.
The full Mac-first epic remains active, including native larger selections/coherence, corpus, runtime admission/integration, accessibility, all portable consumers, then full Web authoring/parity.
